_meta.what: Last ACCEPTED byte sizes for append-only docs, read by handoff-preflight.py.
why: decisions.md is an append-only architectural log that is legitimately large and is
already ~4x any sane absolute cap. Gating it on an absolute number would block every
/handoff until someone swept. It is gated on GROWTH SINCE THIS RECORDED SIZE instead,
which is change-keyed: a normal handoff appending a decision or two passes; an unswept
accumulation past the growth budget trips it.
An ABSENT or corrupt file here does NOT mean 'fine' — handoff-preflight.py falls back
to an absolute cap that decisions.md already exceeds, so it fails CLOSED.
how_to_update: THEN record the post-sweep size here. Do NOT raise this number merely to silence the
gate: it records a size that was ACCEPTED after a sweep, not merely the current one.
_meta.sweep_owed: decisions.md is ~1.03MB, roughly 4x the 262,144-byte fallback cap. A sweep to .claude/memory/decisions-archive.md is owed; the growth budget only stops it getting WORSE.
